params.name: fromDateTime
params.description:
Date-time with an offset of the beginning of the search. Format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ
Example 2020-01-01T09:00:00+00:00

params.name: toDateTime
params.description:
Date-time with an offset of the end of the search. Format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ
Example 2020-01-01T09:00:00+00:00

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of elements returned by this call. The maximum must be less than or equal to 200.

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset of the first element to return. Starting at this offset, the query will return a maximum of 'limit' elements.

items.docs: Gives the current reservation mode status of the account. The reservation mode status is true if the reservation mode is ON else it is false.
Changes the current reservation mode by entering the wanted mode. Enter true to switch on or false to switch off.
